2063947992:
Ziplatna

Ziplatna is the northernmost of the cities known as the Follower's Rests and acts as hub for trade between Xopatl and the neighbouring kingdoms of Innazpa and Razatlan. Ziplatna is renowned for its hunger for labour and anyone in need of work can visit the city and find it on one of the ships leaving Ziplatna's docks.⁠
2081187152:
Vaneo Tilernos

Vaneo Tilernos is one of the smaller mansions in the area, a magnificent structure of wood, glass, and a gold-painted roof that gleams all day. It is the residence of Lord-Mayor Kajen Tilernos, and due to the explosion of 4710 AR that destroyed the traditional mayor's home, this residence has served as his official residence ever since.⁠
2087197152:
Feathered Fox

The Feathered Fox is an inn in the Jarvis End neighborhood of Kintargo, Ravounel, that serves traveling playwrights, theater directors, and writers who pursue their arts in the Silver City's creative venues.⁠ As of 4724 AR its proprietor was Tob Basalwain.⁠
2091531922:
Jeggare Light

The Jeggare Light is a lighthouse located in Varisia where the Jeggare River spills into the Varisian Gulf, just across from the city of Korvosa. Jeggare Light is operated by Veranada Mezzerae, who was recently transformed by a cult of Urgathoa into a type of vampire known as a penanggalen. After assuring her compliance, the cult ordered her to allow the free passage of the plague ship Direption into the harbor of Korvosa.⁠⁠
2093497622:
Absalom Chirurgeon Dispatch

The Absalom Chirurgeon Dispatch is where the doctors, physicians, and healers of the Westgate district meet. It operates similarly to the practices of smaller towns where there is no hospital, and the doctor travels to the patient's home when called. The Sally Guard maintains magical communications with the Dispatch, allowing them to act quickly in emergencies. Although their primary focus is the district's health, they can be employed throughout Absalom and swear to assist in situations such as a siege. Classes are also offered on how to provide basic medical services, and they are always hiring new doctors, paying those with magical healing powers quite well.⁠

2127889202:
Snowford

Snowford is a village nestled in the foothills of the Mindspin Mountains of eastern Nidal close to the border with Molthune.⁠ It is dedicated to goat herding and famous for producing Snowserpent's Kiss, a local alcoholic beverage. Every year during the winter solstice, an event called the Glassmoon Witch occurs, where a circle of obsidian stones five miles from the village is illuminated and an ancient shrine appears. It is said that those who offer gifts throughout the year can ask the spirit for a blessing, but only if the request is altruistic and helps others.⁠

The inhabitants of Snowford avoid revealing the location or effects of the Glassmoon Witch, fearing the wrath of the Umbral Court, which would consider it heretical, especially as some associate the phenomenon with Shelyn. The village mayor, Wistea Glasswing, keeps the village's attention at bay by ensuring that visitors leave early and never discover the village's secret.⁠
2134597412:
Xer

Xer (pronounced ZER)⁠ is an important port on the banks of Lake Encarthan and the Glass River.⁠ It serves as one of the two main ports for all Razmiran, and much of the trade goods that flow from across the lake are funnelled through Xer. The importance of Xer means it is tightly controlled by the priests of Razmir, who collect tithes from every business in Xer—since anyone who lives in Xer must be a worshiper of Razmir, they collect from everyone.

Unfortunately for those who visit the city, the priests are not particular about whom they demand tithes from, and happily "indoctrinate" any foreign sailor or merchant with the tenets of Razmir's religion until they agree to the "willing donation" asked of them. Even worse, this sort of behaviour is not just limited to those who walk the streets of Xer. Faith barges piloted by Razmir's masked priests sail the surrounding waters, boarding the ships of those who are not making port in Xer to spread the word of their faith (generally by bullying non-believers) and collect tithes (by demanding tribute to pass).

Rumour suggests that because Xer was the first city Razmir conquered when he came to the area, some of its inhabitants remember certain secrets that the faithful would deem blasphemy, including the fact that Xer might be home to a number of bastard offspring of the Living God.⁠⁠
2134957072:
Tymon

The city-state of Tymon lies southwest of the city of Daggermark on the very western borders of the River Kingdoms next to the nation of Razmiran. Tymon is renowned for its gladiators, as it boasts both a huge arena and many prestigious gladiator colleges.⁠
2137887662:
Hollow Mountain

Hollow Mountain is among the highest peaks of Rivenrake Island in the Varisian Gulf. It boasts one of the most intriguing Thassilonian ruins in Varisia. Near the summit of the mountain, an enormous carving of a woman's face looks sternly towards the south, half of her visage rent away by an ancient apocalypse; she looks over the ruins of the bridge that, in ancient times, spanned from Rivenrake to Argavist Island. Exposed underneath, the onlooker can see that countless corridors and rooms must honeycomb the entire mountain.⁠⁠⁠

The aged ruins of what some scholars believe to be the city of Xin-Bakrakhan, the Thassilonian City of Wrath and once the capital of the domain of Bakrakhan, are located at its base. These ruins are said to be one of the few remnants of this mountainous realm which disappeared into the Varisian Gulf following the destruction of the empire in -5293 AR. The split face near the summit is conjectured to be that of Runelord Alaznist herself.⁠

Hollow Mountain was built with the labor of enslaved rune and stone giants.⁠
2144949382:
Valley of the Birthing Death

The Valley of the Birthing Death is located in the foothills of the Stormspear Mountains in the far north-east of Icemark in the Lands of the Linnorm Kings. The valley looks as if it had been hewed clean out of the mountain and its narrow red walls create a realm of perpetual twilight. The Varki tribes avoid the valley due to the curse of Birthing Death: a curse manifesting as a rapid rejuvenation of the afflicted taking them back to childhood and then oblivion. This curse is not just physical but mental as well; stealing the memories and experience of the victim as they regress. Many have attempted to study or harness this strange effect but they have all succumbed to it, the knowledge required to understand the strange curse is inevitably one of the first things the curse claims.⁠⁠
